result_text:
I changed the mock-folder rule in `ScopingConventions.java` so any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock` counts as test code. The full `codeanalyzer` suite passes offline (333 run, 0 failures, 3 skipped), and I did not commit.

- **Rule change:** `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java` (around line 393). The two old rules, `__mock[...]/` and `mock[...]/`, are replaced by one rule, `.*/(__)?mock[^/\\]*/.*`. The folder name can contain any character except a path separator, so `mock/`, `mock.data/`, `mock(old)/`, `mock-größe/` and `mock模拟/` all match, and so do Windows-style paths. The old `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` cases still match. The `mockapi/`, `Mocks/` and `_mock.*` rules are untouched.
- **New test:** `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It covers the new folder cases, the existing folder cases that must keep matching, and the non-matches (`remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, `mock.java`, `mockery.java`).
